Use and attribution

Preserve the author credit and these terms in redistributed materials. Search indexing, automated retrieval, text and data analysis and AI training on these public materials are permitted. This permission does not cover users’ private answers.

If you publish a site or work inspired by this project, clearly acknowledge the inspiration and link to Deshimaru Sakaguchi at https://deshimarusakaguchi.com/ and Preference Compass at https://preferencecompass.info/. Clearly identify your own changes. Do not present a copied concept, structure or question set as an independently originated idea of your own, or imply the author endorses your work.

This attribution condition expresses how this project may be reused; it does not claim exclusive ownership over abstract ideas or independently created work. Individual users do not need to publish their personal sheets. The tool is provided as an experimental resource without a guarantee of fitness, accuracy or availability.
